packageRules.description: Standalone Focalboard is end-of-life. docker.io/mattermost/focalboard last received a version tag on 2023-10-11, and 7.11.4 (2023-09-26) is the highest semver tag it will ever carry. The final upstream release, v8.0.0 (2024-06-13), is a Mattermost-plugin-only release for which no standalone server image was ever published, so there is nothing here to bump to. Should a tag turn up anyway, it needs a human to look at it rather than an automerge. This is also why the //patch-automerge preset is deliberately not extended.
